final: SELECT AVG(avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_invoice_ratio, AVG(invoice_ratio - overall_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_overall_ratio FROM (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING invoice_ratio > (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(derived_total_cost) / SUM(product_price) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number)))
